issue.title: [trixie] `test_rexec_without_password_input` in sonic-utilities is hanging on Trixie

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

The `test_rexec_without_password_input` test case in `sonic-utilities` has been hanging on Python 3.13 on Trixie. Specifically, when the code is trying to read the password, the pytest process is getting the SIGTTOU signal, suggesting that two processes want to write to the terminal at the same time.

### Steps to Reproduce

In the `trixie` branch, in `src/sonic-utilities/tests/remote_cli_test.py`, remove the skip decorator for the `test_rexec_without_password_input` test cases. Then, run that test case via pytest.

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Tests should pass.

resolution.title: Issue 23798: (trixie) Wrap getpass.getpass in a signal handler to avoid SIGTTOU
resolution.description:
#### What I did

Python 3.13 will raise a SIGTTOU signal when getpass.getpass is called in a background process, like when running under pytest. Add a signal handler to `tests/remote_cli_test.py` to handle SIGTTOU whenever `getpass.getpass()` is called, since this will raise SIGTTOU when running `trixie`.

This closes [#23798](https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/issues/23798)

#### How I did it

Wrap the call in a signal handler to ignore the signal. This avoids a hang when running `trixie`.
